title: VeriTrace: Evolving Mental Models for Deep Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.26081v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep research agents face vast, interdependent, and pervasively uncertain information. Existing systems explore what evolving intermediate representations should look like, but leave their evolution to the LLM's implicit reasoning. Without explicit regulation, the intermediate layer is easily contaminated by mixed-quality information, and errors propagate along its dependencies, so model scale often ends up substituting for absent regulation. We argue that an agent's mental model should instead evolve through explicit feedback that continuously aligns task understanding with reality, and identify three regulatory loops: interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision. We realise this in VeriTrace, a cognitive-graph framework that explicitly implements the three loops. Using matched Qwen3.5-27B backbones, VeriTrace improves over the strongest matched baseline by an average of 4.82 pp on DeepResearch Bench (DRB) Insight (1

translated_title: VeriTrace：面向深度研究智能体的心智模型演化
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体面临海量、相互关联且普遍存在不确定性的信息。现有系统探索了不断演化的中间表示应该是什么样子，却将其演化过程交由大语言模型的隐式推理来完成。在缺乏显式调控的情况下，中间层容易被混合质量的信息污染，错误会沿着依赖关系传播，因此模型规模往往不得不替代缺失的调控机制。我们主张，智能体的心智模型应当通过显式反馈来演化，持续将任务理解与现实对齐，并识别出三个调控回路：解释性更新、偏差反馈和模式修订。我们在 VeriTrace 中实现了这一理念，这是一个显式实现这三个回路的认知图框架。在使用相同的 Qwen3.5-27B 骨干模型的条件下，VeriTrace 在 DeepResearch Bench (DRB) Insight 上相比最强的同配置基线平均提升了 4.82 个百分点。
tldr: 提出 VeriTrace 认知图框架，通过解释性更新、偏差反馈和模式修订三个显式调控回路，使深度研究智能体的心智模型持续演化并与现实对齐，在 DRB Insight 上相比最强基线平均提升 4.82 个百分点。
en_tdlr: VeriTrace is a cognitive-graph framework that evolves deep research agents' mental models through three explicit regulatory loops—interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision—improving over the strongest matched baseline by an average of 4.82 pp on DRB Insight.
